text:
Dear Ms Morgan,

first, so there's no misunderstanding: nothing in my flat has been cleaned up, repaired or changed since the theft. The police officer who came on 31 January told me to leave things as they were, and I have.

I'm attaching the police report and the purchase records for the stolen things with what I paid for them.

Nobody broke in, and that's what makes me so cross with myself. On Saturday 31 January, a little before ten in the morning, I ran down to the bakery at the corner and pulled the flat door shut behind me without locking it, as I sometimes do for a quick errand. I was gone perhaps a quarter of an hour. When I came back the door was just as I'd left it, closed but unlocked, and my handbag was gone from the hall, and so was my jewellery box from the bedroom shelf.

Nothing about it was urgent from my side. I phoned you on Monday 2 February, you told me I could go ahead with new locks, and only after that did I book the locksmith.

My keys were in the handbag, together with a letter with my address on it. So the locksmith replaced the cylinders of my flat door and my letterbox on 4 February, with new keys. That cost CHF 2,280, and I'd like this to be part of my claim, together with the stolen things.

All of this happened at home, in my flat at Bahnhofstrasse 137 in Wädenswil, which I rent from Erlenhof Holdings. The stolen items come to CHF 8,100.

Thank you for your help so far.

Yours sincerely,
Ruth Gerber

Kantonspolizei Zürich – Polizeiposten Wädenswil
Police report (Polizeirapport)

File no.: KAPO-ZH 26-01-3375
Complaint made: 31.01.2026, 12:05, at the Wädenswil police post
Complainant: Ruth Gerber, Bahnhofstrasse 137, Wädenswil

Facts as stated: On 31.01.2026 between approx. 09:45 and 10:00 the complainant left her flat for a short errand and closed the door without locking it. On her return she found that a handbag (with keys, wallet and a letter) had been taken from the hall and a jewellery box from the bedroom. The door showed no damage.

The complainant requests a criminal investigation and files a criminal complaint. Investigation opened.

Polizeiposten Wädenswil
